title: Public Information Act request: Dallas Love Field security incident, November 14, 2026 (Lovefield Airport Dallas Texas)

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Texas Public Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

To: City of Dallas Police Department, Open Records [confirm current submission portal or address]

Under Texas Government Code Chapter 552, I request the following:

The computer-aided dispatch (CAD) call history and event log for Dallas Love Field (8008 Herb Kelleher Way) for November 14, 2026, from 8:30 p.m. to 9:15 CST. Please include call numbers, call types, dispatch and arrival times, and disposition codes.
The incident report(s) for the security incident that involved a commercial aircraft at Dallas Love Field on that date, including the case number(s) [insert if known] and any related call numbers [insert: ___].
Any supplemental reports, offense reports, and officer narratives related to items 1 and 2.

The fire department run number would be 2026332035 including units 737,786,806,807,896,BC01,BC03,BC06,BC07,BC09,EN03,EN11,EN27,EN35,EN42,EN43,EN47,HM03,RD01,RD02,RD03,RD21,RE03,RE27,RE33,RE42,RE47,TR03,TR11,TR27,TR33,TR36,TR43,US27,US33. They were on scene from approximately 8:30 PM until 9PM.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Peter Herring
